stories.summary: Fresh reviewed summary of at least twenty characters.

hard_rules: Before the handoff advances, create and validate the versioned publication manifest. Every required artifact must exist, use a supported schema or explicit legacy adapter, and match its git_blob_sha1 digest.
MEDIA_READY is immutable after manifest validation. Deterministic publication may consume the selected media and its verification receipt but must not repair, rediscover, or rewrite media metadata.
WATCHLIST_READY is immutable after manifest validation. Render and public projection must use the manifest-bound dated Watchlist artifact, never whichever _data/watchlist.json happens to be newest.
The accepted image-review path must be named explicitly in the publication manifest. Production must not silently choose between dated and legacy review paths.

Before handoff, run `_tools/validate-handoff-images.mjs`. Then create accepted WebP or PNG blobs with the authenticated GitHub Git Data API (`create_blob` with `encoding=base64`), compose one tree/commit, and advance only the isolated handoff ref with `update_ref`. Do not use native git credentials or GitHub Contents API/create_file/update_file for binary image bytes.
Do not perform article-source network retrieval in Work. Use only the committed nine-candidate GitHub Actions article-evidence packet.

Work must not run `_tools/discover-sources.mjs` or the metadata gate. Those execute in GitHub Actions preflight with zero model calls. Work may read only the preflight `result/metadata-candidates.json` and `result/receipt.json` after `coverage_ready=true`.
Continue past metadata gating only when coverage_ready=true, every candidate has date_status=resolved_metadata_date, each focus_hint has at least three candidates, and agent_skill_signals>=1.
Run fresh deterministic discovery with DAB_RESEARCH_CUTOFF set to the original edition cutoff before the metadata gate.
Before any model inspects article discovery candidates, run `_tools/under80-metadata-gate.mjs`; never open the raw discovery queue. The committed gate output must contain at most 20 candidates.
Kernel must contain exactly six stories in ordered 2/2/2 allocation and exactly one agent_skill=true.
Facts and image manifests must contain every selected candidate_id.
Use the stable internal focus id `agents_non_technical_people` for compatibility, but all current reader-facing display labels must be `Agents for Everyone`.

Media is fail-closed: the handoff must contain exactly two verified videos and exactly two verified source-diverse podcasts. Empty or omitted production media slots are invalid; preserve the last valid edition and stop for targeted media recovery.
All six story images must be fresh accepted full-quality images; prefer 1200×630 WebP, with PNG accepted when needed for a from-scratch qualification test.
Push the handoff manifest once, then end Work immediately; do not run deterministic release stages in Work.

For a qualification test, use execution_mode=qualification_nonproduction and an editorial-handoff/qualification/* branch. That mode prohibits publication PR creation, publication-candidate labeling, main merge, Pages deployment, and production mutation.

Beginning with the 2026-09-24 edition, every accepted image manifest entry must include story_id, sha256, 1200x630 dimensions, inspection_result=pass, locked=true, accepted_locked=true, lock_status=accepted_locked, and the canonical Git blob identity returned by create_blob.

Beginning with the 2026-09-24 edition, persist a current-day media preflight receipt bound to the editorial-kernel SHA-256, with exactly two videos and two podcasts, verification timestamps/evidence, and a passing two-source podcast-diversity result. Reuse it unchanged on downstream retries while the kernel hash is unchanged.
Beginning with the 2026-09-26 edition, structural_gate and editorial_quality_gate are independent. overall_gate=pass only when both pass; a technically valid image is never sufficient by itself.

Beginning with the 2026-09-26 edition, the publication manifest must bind image_quality_evidence as a versioned 2.0.0 artifact and include it in IMAGES_READY and HANDOFF_COMMITTED lifecycle dependencies.

Editorial image review must compare all six rendered images against _records/image-quality/benchmark-profile-v1.json and preserve dimension-level evidence for professional finish, meaningful detail, explanatory mechanism, annotation richness, visual depth, hierarchy, composition, story specificity and differentiation.

Image replacement is append-only evidence: use a new asset version, content hash and cache key, identify the superseded asset, and require post-deployment byte verification. Do not silently overwrite accepted evidence.
